```yaml
name: Skill Check Token Usage

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  collect-metrics:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'
      
      - name: Run Metrics Collector
        working-directory: ./skill-validator
        run: dotnet run --project MetricsCollector.csproj -- --output-file-path ../data/token-usage.json

  aggregate-data:
    needs: collect-metrics
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up PowerShell
        uses: styfle/cross-powershell@v1
      
      - name: Aggregate Token Data
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          powershell -File generate-token-data.ps1
          powershell -File generate-benchmark-data.ps1

  build-dashboard:
    needs: aggregate-data
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '16'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: ./dashboard
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Build Dashboard
        working-directory: ./dashboard
        run: npm run build

  deploy-dashboard:
    needs: build-dashboard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./dashboard/dist
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a pipeline to collect token usage metrics, aggregate them, build a dashboard, and deploy it to GitHub Pages. The workflow is triggered on pushes and pull requests to the `main` branch.

name: Skill Check Token Usage

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  collect-metrics:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'
      
      - name: Run Metrics Collector
        working-directory: ./skill-validator
        run: dotnet run --project MetricsCollector.csproj -- --output-file-path ../data/token-usage.json

  aggregate-data:
    needs: collect-metrics
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up PowerShell
        uses: styfle/cross-powershell@v1
      
      - name: Aggregate Token Data
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          powershell -File generate-token-data.ps1
          powershell -File generate-benchmark-data.ps1

  build-dashboard:
    needs: aggregate-data
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '16'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: ./dashboard
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Build Dashboard
        working-directory: ./dashboard
        run: npm run build

  deploy-dashboard:
    needs: build-dashboard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./dashboard/dist
